sources.title: webxos/microd-bigram-v2 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This model was produced with Micro Distillery v2.5 — a single-file HTML PWA that fetches open corpora, trains a bigram model, applies optional NLP fan-out polish, and exports a HuggingFace-ready .zip bundle. Includes the Jev Code Nous deterministic API layer for coding-focused token prediction (harness only).

sources.title: GitHub - webxos/microcuda: MicroCUDA is a lightweight framework that ...
sources.snippet: MICROCUDA v2.2 (UNDER DEVELOPMENT) MicroCUDA is a lightweight framework that brings GPU‑like compute abstractions and a local AI agent to your CPU. It simulates a CUDA runtime using OpenMP and SIMD (AVX2/AVX‑512). MICROCUDA runs large language models via Ollama, and provides a terminal user interface (TUI) for interacting with the AI agent.
